question: Evaluate the integral of (2x + 3) dx from 0 to 2.
student_answer: I do not know how to find the anti-derivative function because I do not know what the reverse power rule of differentiation is.

chunks.text: Evaluation of definite integrals relies on the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus: integral of f(x)dx = F(b) - F(a), where F is the antiderivative obtained via power rules.
